title: SE(3)-MeanFlow: Few-Step Protein Backbone Generation on Lie Groups
abstract: arXiv:2607.27431v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative modeling of protein backbones promises the de novo design of proteins with prescribed structural and functional properties. Existing diffusion and flow-matching models produce high-quality backbones on SE(3)^N, but inference requires numerically integrating an ODE over hundreds of network evaluations, each involving a Lie group exponential map - a bottleneck for high-throughput design campaigns. We introduce SE(3)-MeanFlow, a few-step generative framework that extends MeanFlow from Euclidean space to the Lie group geometry of protein frames. Working natively in the Lie algebra so(3) and in R^3, we derive closed-form average-velocity identities for rotations and translations, giving simulation-free training targets. We further introduce an SE(3) alpha-Flow objective that removes the Jacobian-vector product from the rotation branch and serves as a warm-up stage, after which training switches to a small-t stabilized Mea

translated_title: SE(3)-MeanFlow：在李群上快速生成蛋白质骨架的少步方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.27431v4 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：蛋白质骨架的生成建模有望实现具有预定结构和功能特性的蛋白质的从头设计。现有的扩散和流匹配模型能够在SE(3)^N上生成高质量的骨架，但推理过程需要对常微分方程进行数值积分，涉及数百次网络评估，每次评估都包含李群指数映射——这成为高通量设计活动的瓶颈。我们引入了SE(3)-MeanFlow，一个少步生成框架，将MeanFlow从欧几里得空间扩展到蛋白质框架的李群几何结构。通过在so(3)李代数和R^3空间中原生工作，我们推导出旋转和平移的平均速度闭式恒等式，提供了无模拟的训练目标。我们进一步引入了SE(3) alpha-Flow目标，该目标从旋转分支中移除了雅可比向量积，并作为预热阶段，之后训练切换到小时间步稳定的MeanFlow变体。
tldr: 本文提出SE(3)-MeanFlow框架，通过李代数中的闭式平均速度推导和alpha-Flow预热目标，实现无需ODE积分的少步蛋白质骨架生成，显著提升推理效率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SE(3)-MeanFlow, a few-step generative framework that achieves simulation-free training via closed-form average-velocity identities in the Lie algebra and an alpha-Flow warm-up objective, enabling efficient protein backbone generation without ODE integration.
